RetrieveAllComputedFields
data.value: SELECT schema_name(obj.schema_id) as schema_name, object_name(clm.object_id) as table_name, clm.name as column_name, type_name(user_type_id) as data_type, clm.max_length, definition FROM sys.computed_columns clm JOIN sys.objects obj on obj.object_id = clm.object_id ORDER BY schema_name, table_name, column_id;

data.value: SELECT Type, Type_desc FROM sys.sql_modules m INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON m.object_id=o.object_id WHERE type_desc like '%function%' AND name='{0}'
